integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from the standard zero count for nondegenerate quadratic forms over finite fields, which is stated and proved as Lemma 6.5 of the cited source. The originality comparison distinguishes the source's untwisted theorem from its explicitly open twisted problem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the rank-one stratum for nondegenerate diagonal twists over odd finite fields.
It does not give the higher-rank recurrence or a classification for arbitrary non-diagonal Gram matrices.
Finite exhaustive checks corroborate selected cases but are not used as the infinite proof.
title: Flag-sensitive rank-one twisted Cholesky zero fibers
